name: [Sigma] Known Botnet Credential Marker Used Against SSH (345gs5662d34)
description:
Login attempt using the username '345gs5662d34', a hard-coded credential
string seen in 1,523 login events during this lab's 14-day Cowrie run and
widely reported in public honeypot telemetry as a botnet marker (it is sent
as both username and password). Written against events observed in the
archived dataset. The attempted password is not matched on: it is outside
the ADR-005 dictionary, so it is stored length-redacted.
query: from cowrie-* metadata _id, _index, _version | where (event.action in ("cowrie.login.failed", "cowrie.login.success")) and user.name=="345gs5662d34"
false_positives: None expected; the string is not a plausible legitimate account name
author: dram64
